scope: Static native regular branches and retained client prefab data; no source or test modifications.

findings.finding: Readiness checks the receiving Ability timer and affecting state; StartCastingInternal writes that Ability casting flag. The inspected low-level paths do not perform an owner-wide casting scan.

Normal Character and Enemy attack states serialize their main action; transitions and explicit trigger paths arrange interruption. This is behavior-level coordination, not a global Ability storage invariant.

TriggerAbility looks up a named attached Ability on the source and calls it. Mudrock S2 root has a SOURCE -> RollAttack trigger before healing. This shows nested execution; it is not evidence of two prolonged player-visible main attacks.
Queries, startup availability and interruption have separate entry points. PRTS distinguishes combat-disarm admission from Buff-driven cancellation.
The regular finish path calls CleanupForNextCast (slot 43), OnCastEnd (slot 53), cooldown policy, then finish callbacks. Source-level callback names need not be mirrored.
EnemySkill Tick skips its skill timer update when its Ability is casting. _OnCastFinish resets that timer with Reset(true). This timer must not be conflated with the Ability attack timer.
CombatWrapper _PickAbility accumulates eligible skills from one priority level and obtains the battle RNG for candidate selection. PRTS explicitly documents random choice among equal priority skills.

findings: DISARMED interrupts normal attacks; DISARMED_COMBAT admission and Buff-driven interruption are separate.
SILENCED applies to silenceable skills and abilities; it is not a universal cancellation of every execution.
Forced skill triggers distinguish interrupting the current action from only triggering when idle.
Shared enemy skill documentation specifies priority ties are randomized and skill cooldowns may pause during casting or inactive modes.
S2 triggers when eligible regardless of the current attack period; this statement alone does not prove prolonged parallel casting.

limits: No XLua hotfix execution or live gameplay recording.
Ordinary main-action serialization is established for the inspected native paths, not every content program.
Nested child Ability execution need not be represented by a second Stronghold Action instance.
The public wiki reference and installed client are version-bounded evidence; no assertion that all current content matches these static branches.
